fault_tree.limitations: Independent primitive event processes with explicit shared-cause events; exponential operating failure times and independent repairs. No repair-resource competition, coverage, wear-out or systematic-defect rate inference.

inspection.limitations: Perfect periodic proof-test detection and restoration, constant hardware rate, uniform demand timing; actual diagnostic coverage and repair exposure remain open.

maintenance.limitations: M/M/c mean queue wait and independent Poisson replenishment pipeline with fixed mean turnaround. Crews are concurrent service teams, not roster headcount; correlated fleet outages, shifts, skills and logistics require separate modelling.

thermal.limitations: Single lumped heat capacity and constant heat/conductance/ambient; no hydraulic, spatial, phase-change or runaway model.
thermal.uncertainty: Parameter-corner sensitivity; no statistical confidence or validated hotspot bound.

quantitative_analysis.top_event: Circulation and primary flow diagnostic protection unavailable; this precursor is not a quantified battery fire hazard. Independent BMS temperature protection remains a separate assessment.

nodes.title: Resource controller

nodes.statement: Bounded position, integrity and speed must limit movement and inhibit/brake on invalid inputs.
Departure requires isolation, physical connector clearance, locked doors, usable authority and energy.

Both logical channels must agree to permit; loss/disagreement/replay/feedback failure actually injected while moving must latch zero torque/emergency within one 50 ms virtual step; retained protection and stopped authorised recovery only.
Recovery, maintenance, train division and rescue require qualified proving and privileged local procedure; no dashboard bypass.
Conflicting resources retain ownership through expiry, partition and restart; no conflicting occupancy.
